author: agent:claude-code
message: CI's tend job can't run until tend is published; recorded as a todo and the obstacle behind it.

title: Check the design in CI once tend is published
body: tend and vg-paradigms aren't on GitHub, so the tend CI job (vaibhav-gopal/tend/.github/actions/check) couldn't resolve its action and was taken out of ci.yml. autodyne is public, and GitHub never lets a public repo `uses:` an action from a private one: once tend is published (privately) with releases, add a job that downloads the release with a REPOS_TOKEN secret and runs `tend check --strict`, as the action does, rather than `uses:` it. Until then `tend check --strict` runs locally before each push.

waits_on.on: tend published on GitHub with releases

title: Tend's CI check can't run here yet
body: The tend job failed with 'Unable to resolve action vaibhav-gopal/tend, repository not found': neither tend nor vg-paradigms has a GitHub remote. A public repo (autodyne) also can't use a private repo's action at all, so the eventual job fetches the release itself. Also found while looking: no CI job had run since 7eb934a (an unquoted ': ' in a run line broke the workflow file), fixed in 4812e80.
